_provenance: Deterministic whole-word, case-preserving counterfactual renaming table for the citric acid cycle's specific molecules, enzymes, and cofactors. No LLM in the loop - fully auditable. Purpose: remove the model's ability to answer from pre-trained biochemistry knowledge alone, so studied-vs-unstudied comparisons in the student simulation carry real signal instead of both conditions ceiling at ~100%. Longer/more specific terms are applied before their substrings (e.g. 'alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase' before 'alpha-ketoglutarate' and 'dehydrogenase') to avoid double-substitution corruption.
